Dr. Manoj Chiropractor - Expert Chiropractic Care by Dr. Manoj Kumar

Welcome to Dr. MANOJ CHIROPRACTOR centre , where your health and well-being are our top priorities. Led by Dr. Manoj
 we use evidence-based techniques to treat conditions such as back pain, neck pain, joint discomfort, and posture-related issues.

Visit our centre today and experience the power of natural healing!
Natural . Safe . Effective . Non-Surgical Treatment 

Treatments in Our Centre 
► Lumber Spondylitis 
► Cervical Spondylitis   
► Back Pain
► Neck Pain
► Sciatica & Leg pain 
► Knee Pain
► Ankylosis spondylitis
► Sports Injury
► Dizziness & Vertigo 
► Frozen shoulder 
► Posture correction 
► Joint adjustment
► Disc Bulge 
► Disc Herniate
► Slip disc
► Migraine
► Spine alignment & mobility issues 
► Chiropractic Adjustment 
► Chiropractic treatment 
► Scoliosis 

Dr.Manoj Kumar -DEMS MD(CH.T) 
Kotrani, Phagwara,  Kapurthala Punjab.
